obligations.requirement: The common Debug UI exposes exactly Dashboard, Control, Inspect, Runtime, Performance and Scenarios as top-level workspaces.
obligations.oracle: PX0PanelRegistry asserts WorkspaceId::kCount == 6 and exact labels/order. PX0Workbench renders/declares all six navigation items and no seventh workspace.
obligations.acceptance: No legacy DebugPanel top-level taxonomy remains as an independent navigation model.

obligations.requirement: PanelSlot encodes the approved core sections and stable feature slots with a deterministic valid workspace/slot relation.
obligations.oracle: PX0PanelRegistry attempts valid registrations in every workspace, explicitly registers synthetic Control/Feature and Inspect/Object contributions, rejects cross-workspace slot pairs, rejects null render callbacks, and verifies null visible means visible.
obligations.acceptance: Feature extension proof does not require modifying Workbench core.

obligations.requirement: PanelRegistry uses explicit composition-time registration and deterministic ordering.
obligations.oracle: PX0PanelRegistry registers mixed slots/orders and asserts returned order is slot enum order then ascending order with stable insertion ties. Structural/source review finds no static-global registry, reflection or plugin discovery.
obligations.acceptance: contributions(workspace) returns a bounded span/view over that workspace's explicitly registered contributions.

obligations.requirement: Panels receive only DebugSnapshot, DebugControlRouter and DebugUiSessionState.
obligations.oracle: Compile-time contract test constructs DebugPanelContext with exactly those references. panel.hpp contains no SemanticDocument, RuntimeScene, SpatialIndex, SkSurface, InkPlaygroundHost, RuntimeFacade, diagnostics-provider or owner-control pointer members.
obligations.acceptance: Panel = Snapshot -> UI -> Intent remains enforceable by the common contract.

obligations.requirement: Workspace navigation and other PX0-04 session state are UI-local and do not mutate Runtime/Debug owners.
obligations.oracle: PX0Workbench changes selected workspace through DebugUiSessionState while fake RuntimeFacade/AxiomDebugControl/PlatformDebugControl call counts remain zero. Default selected workspace is Dashboard.
obligations.acceptance: No Runtime/Document generation or owner request is produced by workspace navigation.

obligations.requirement: The common renderer presents header/sidebar/content/footer Workbench structure without docking and without 410x560 as semantic layout.
obligations.oracle: PX0Workbench/structural test proves common Workbench owns the six-item sidebar, active workspace content, header health summary and latest-activity footer; workbench.cpp contains no ImGui docking API and does not set 410x560 as fixed semantic size.
obligations.acceptance: Empty workspaces render explicit empty/not-yet-migrated content.

obligations.requirement: Before PX0-05 capability migration, existing Debug UI controls remain reachable through one transitional legacy compatibility contribution without creating new product/debug semantics.
obligations.oracle: DUI20DebugUiContracts and structural review show Selection, Undo/Redo, Brush/Eraser, Pan and Surface controls still call DebugControlRouter, the top-level UI is the Workbench shell, and the legacy compatibility body is not registered as a new top-level workspace.
obligations.acceptance: No existing control silently falls back to raw owner mutation and no new Shape/RichText/Connector/Snap/Image control appears.

obligations.requirement: ImGuiSkiaRenderer is moved out of controller without changing Skia rendering behavior.
obligations.oracle: Structural test verifies renderer declaration/implementation moved to imgui_skia_renderer.hpp/.cpp; A8 atlas, normalized UV transform, white paint and SkBlendMode::kModulate remain present; controller.cpp no longer owns Skia renderer implementation.
obligations.acceptance: Windows app build or equivalent native target compiles against the moved renderer.
obligations.evidence_required: Windows structural contract + native build target

obligations.requirement: DebugController owns the common assembler/router/activity/registry/session/workbench composition and observes one diagnostics capture identity per controller frame.
obligations.oracle: PX0Workbench controller test uses counting fake providers: buildImGuiFrame performs the approved capture->beginFrame->refreshReceipts->activity replacement->store->render order, snapshot identity comes from one assembler capture sequence, and receipt refresh does not add provider reads.
obligations.acceptance: Controller exposes snapshot() and uiState() while panels receive no raw owners.

obligations.requirement: PanelCapability/panels.hpp and DebugPanel/PanelState are retired, while platform host convergence remains deferred.
obligations.oracle: Exact tree shows panels.hpp absent and controller.hpp has no DebugPanel/PanelState taxonomy. If DebugPanelModel remains, it has no describe()/old taxonomy. Windows/Web platform production files are unchanged from task anchor.
obligations.acceptance: New WorkspaceId/PanelSlot is the only common top-level panel taxonomy and PX0-06 work is not pulled forward.

obligations.requirement: PX0-04 proves the shell/extension architecture only.
obligations.oracle: Exact diff has no final per-workspace panel source split under debug_ui/src/panels/, no Scenario runner activation, no Windows/Web host composition-root migration, no new product feature contracts, no Preview/DUI-M1 evidence mutation.
